text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's an oddball, but there seems to be
more to
her than meets the eye.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I totally get you. I love the way
she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue is full of Agnes Tachyon's
fans!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, the autumn Tenno Sho isn't
hailed as the
definitive medium-distance
race for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the lively stands, the
racecourse is
full of strained tension.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not in the slightest! Overexcitement is

detrimental to the ability to focus.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling nervous after all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely relaxed. But I still want
to get the
most out of this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I feel like I can run really well today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It took a lot to get all the way here.
That's why
I'm not holding anything
back!
